errors.text_span: В секторите са включени етикети с проценти.
errors.evidence: This statement implies that all sectors have percentage labels, but only two of the four sectors (57.1% and 26.2%) actually have them.

errors.text_span: Секторите изглеждат подредени по низходящ размер, започвайки от жълтия сектор и продължавайки по посока на часовниковата стрелка.
errors.evidence: The sectors are not arranged in descending order clockwise. Starting from the largest sector (yellow, 57.1%), the next sector clockwise is the smallest (blue), followed by the second smallest (orange), and then the second largest (gray, 26.2%). This is not a descending order.
